mechanism: Both drugs cause CNS depression through different pathways (benzodiazepine GABA-A agonism and dopamine antagonism), with additive sedative and psychomotor effects; haloperidol may inhibit alprazolam metabolism via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor closely for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and cognitive impairment; use lowest effective doses and consider alternative antipsychotic with lower interaction potential if possible.
